verses.text: Then I looked up, and I saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.
I asked, "Where are you going?" He answered me, "To measure Jerusalem, to find out how wide and how long it is."
Then the angel who was talking with me left, and another angel came to meet him.
He said to him, "Run and tell that young man, 'Jerusalem will be a city without walls, because there will be so many people and animals in it.
And I myself will be a wall of fire around it,' says the LORD, 'and I will be its glory within.'
"Come! Come! Run away from the land of the north," says the LORD, "because I have scattered you to the four winds of heaven," says the LORD.
"Come, Zion! Escape, you who live in Babylon!"
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "After he has honored me, he has sent me against the nations that robbed you. Whoever touches you touches the apple of his eye.
I will raise my hand against them, so that their own slaves will rob them. Then you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.
"Sing and celebrate, people of Zion! I am coming, and I will live among you," says the LORD.
"On that day many nations will join themselves to the LORD and become my people. I will live among you, and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.
The LORD will take Judah as his own share in the holy land, and he will again choose Jerusalem.
Be silent before the LORD, all people, because he has risen up from his holy dwelling place."
